runs.say: How do I make a vertical version of this for Instagram Reels?
runs.reply: You make the vertical one at export time, not by editing: on the project page, choose **Export videos**, pick this video, and tick the **Reels 9:16** preset. Every project starts with that preset (alongside YouTube 16:9 and Feed 1:1, all at web loudness), and you can change it there, for example to burn in captions. That's from the help article "Export many videos at once". The article doesn't say how the wide card gets reframed to fit 9:16, so play the Reels file through once to check that "Get 20% off today only" stays fully on screen.
